notes: nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local (ModelOpt NVFP4 experts, MXFP8 / FP8 dense, quantization-aware distilled from zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash: 320B total, 18B active, hybrid KDA / MLA+DSA attention, mHC) converted by tools/convert_glm_fp4.py: every weight the checkpoint's own (NVFP4 experts with their global scales), the FP8 projections as Q8_0. Sampling as the model's generation_config. No speculation yet (the MTP layer is not built; mtp empty keeps run.sh from loading Qwen's drafter). 159.5 GiB of experts: the GPUs cache the hottest, the RAM arena the next 100 GiB (engine_args --ram-gib), the rest come from the model file. The cache adapts with few swaps (a dropped expert costs a file read into the RAM arena). docs/GLM.md.
